The cache should be rebuilt from docs/state/reckon/runs/ by a recorded command, or written into the run directory.

the loss count is sensitive to which fields the missing cache carried: with the full committed run records it re-measures 12 of 60 rather than 13, because the tokens 7595 and 7690 of one arm table match substrings of manifest_commits SHAs. A token match is a substring test, so incidental hex can mark a claim recoverable that is not; the repository-wide corpus should exclude identifier-shaped hex or require a token boundary before a claim counts as recovered.
